710360501.text: "...The people from Liyue have left their large cannon behind. It shows signs of maintenance. It seems that they have not given up on re-opening the mine..."

710360502.text: "...Scouted the area where the crystal fragment was found, clearing a path for others to follow, before returning here to await further orders..."

710360503.text: "...The sonic catcher is reacting to a greater pulse coming from deeper within the mine... It is a grand, but dull noise..."

710360504.text: "...According to sample analysis, the crystal may be older than The Chasm itself. However, we have not found any systemic signs of ancient civilizations nearby..."

710360601.text: "...The sonic catcher is constantly blaring. It almost reminds me of Fourrier Anton's old grandmother's snoring... We can't use it as-is..."

710360602.text: "...I'm going to call it the 'Babushka,' I think. This issue might have been caused by the radiation from the crystal itself and the influence of that black matter..."

710360603.text: "...I do not have the spare parts to repair the 'Babushka,' so it has to be disassembled. Sorry, grandma. Setting up camp here and awaiting resupply."

710360604.text: "...It seems that someone is observing us from a vantage point nearby. Spotted an unnatural flash. A telescope (or perhaps the scope of a rifle?) Either way, we have to move..."

710360701.text: "...Specialist Bogdana has discovered that the black-colored mud is still constantly propagating. We have to move more swiftly than before..."

710360702.text: "...The anomalous shifts in The Chasm's underground have been gradually increasing in speed. We have to bring the Mokosh Device to the bottom for assembly as soon as possible..."

710360703.text: "...Fourrier Anton reports that a woman has been following us around. We might need to set up some traps and early warning systems..."

710360801.text: "...An explosion has occurred. Cause unknown. The Mokosh Device, which should have theoretically been able to clear the Abyssal corruption from this place, has overloaded and been destroyed..."

710360802.text: "...The black pollutant on the main fragment has begun to regenerate... We need to sum up what we've learned thus far..."

710360803.text: "...One or several hard strikes aimed at key stress points on the main fragment can cause the black matter to retreat..."

710360804.text: "...Our scouting parties have discovered human activity in different locations. Whether they are human or some other creature is unclear... But perhaps they might even be the culprits behind the black matter's propagation..."
